entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: An ancient vampire of Femeref descent who reigns in Aku and drains life from others.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: Shauku's domain in the Uuserk Marshes.

entities.name: Cosmic Horror
entities.description: Being trapped beneath the ruin by a ring of fire; it summons a Falling Star.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Crystal prison in which Shauku locked Johan.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of Robaran Mercenaries who frees Johan.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Asked Shauku to aid his conquest of Jamuraa.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Temporal planeswalker who phased out Zhalfir.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: War during which Kaervek approached Shauku.

events.summary: Shauku lures Emperor Johan to her lair with promises of knowledge, then gives him a tome that drains his knowledge.
events.quote: it instead drained his pre-existing knowledge into its pages.

events.summary: Shauku detects Johan and locks him in an Amber Prison.
events.quote: locked him into an Amber Prison .

events.summary: Adira Strongheart's mercenaries free Johan; Jedit Ojanen knocks Shauku back and the freed Cosmic Horror summons a Falling Star that obliterates the ruin.
events.quote: the freed Cosmic Horror summoned a Falling Star to obliterate the entire ruin.
but she had secretly fled her lair and survived the impact.

events.summary: Kaervek asks Shauku to aid his conquest of Jamuraa; she declines.
events.quote: she was approached by Kaervek to aid him in his conquest of Jamuraa , but she declined.

events.summary: Teferi Akosa phases out Aku and Zhalfir during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Aku and all its surroundings were phased out along with the rest of Zhalfir by the temporal planeswalker Teferi Akosa .
